css: .section.no-top { padding-top: 0; } .button.is-ghost-light { background-color: transparent; color: #f2ede4; border-color: rgba(242, 237, 228, 0.5); } .button.is-ghost-light:hover { background-color: #f2ede4; color: #141613; border-color: #f2ede4; } .cta-band { border-radius: 36px; background-color: #141613; padding: 96px 64px; position: relative; overflow: hidden; } .cta-band-image { position: absolute; right: 0; top: 0; bottom: 0; width: 44%; } .cta-band-content { position: relative; max-width: 560px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; grid-row-gap: 28px; } @media screen and (max-width: 991px) { .cta-band-image { display: none; } } @media screen and (max-width: 767px) { .cta-band { padding: 56px 28px; border-radius: 28px; } }
